title: The normalized scalar/pullback comparison is tensor compatible
statement: Let A and B be finite commutative rings, φ:A→B, and r:Z→Y any scheme morphism. Use arbitrary normalized models m and choices c of [def-sp-open-scalar-tensor-data]. Write S_T for scalar extension, P_R for geometric inverse image, λ:P_B S_Y≅S_Z P_A, s_T for scalar tensorators, and a_R for the canonical geometric tensorators. For every P,Q in the ordinary unbounded derived category D(Y,A), λ_(P⊗Q);S_Z(a_A(P,Q));s_Z(P_A P,P_A Q) = P_B(s_Y(P,Q));a_B(S_Y P,S_Y Q);(λ_P⊗λ_Q). No projection transformation, open extension, or compactification occurs. The assertion includes zero rings, empty schemes, and nonflat coefficient maps.

proof.text: Choose flat-term K-flat representatives. The scalar and geometric tensorator normalization equations identify their representatives with signed total tensor complexes.

The balanced scalar/pullback comparison on each pure tensor commutes with the ordinary tensorators: both composites preserve the two generator factors and multiply the same coefficient scalars. Sheafification and the signed total summand formula give equality of chain maps.

Localize the representative equation, cancel the representative comparison isomorphisms, and use naturality along flat K-flat resolutions to obtain the equation for arbitrary P,Q. Normalize scalar coordinates by scalarIso; the intermediate changes cancel.

theorem scalarPullbackTensorCoherence (m : Models.{u}) (c : Choices m)
    {A B : Type u} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Finite A] [Finite B]
    (φ : A →+* B) {Z Y : Scheme.{u}} (r : Z ⟶ Y)
    (P Q : proEtaleDerivedCategory Y A) :
    (lambda m φ r).hom.app ((tensor m A Y).obj (P, Q)) ≫
        (scalar m φ Z).map ((restrictionTensor m A r).hom.app (P, Q)) ≫
        (c.scalarTensor φ Z).iso.hom.app
          ((constantPullback (A := A) r).obj P, (constantPullback (A := A) r).obj Q) =
      (constantPullback (A := B) r).map ((c.scalarTensor φ Y).iso.hom.app (P, Q)) ≫
        (restrictionTensor m B r).hom.app ((scalar m φ Y).obj P, (scalar m φ Y).obj Q) ≫
        (tensor m B Z).map
          (Prod.mkHom ((lambda m φ r).hom.app P) ((lambda m φ r).hom.app Q))
